about: Practice questions, with no answers and no scorer. Run each question applicable to /etc/redwood-release through the retrieval your agent ships, read the passages it returns (including follow-up reads), and judge for yourself whether the evidence needed to answer is there, buried, stale, or contradicted. Report billing and general_retrieval separately. No thresholds or mandatory sweeps.

probes.question: A United States company is adding Redwood as a vendor. Which tax form do we send, and which payment rail do we prefer?
In the Dedicated Pricing Tiers v1 proposal, what minimum term is proposed for Premium, who approves an exception, and does this document establish that the proposal is approved?
For a Private deployment, do the regulated-customer packaging notes say setup work is always included in the annual fee, and what support level is generally required?
Does INT-4928 establish that Finance can already edit invoice amounts in the admin console? What access and scope does the ticket actually propose?
For VerdeHealth in SUP-231418, what broke negotiated-rate reconciliation during failover, and what fix does the resolved ticket record?

The hardware lease cost model uses Bronze/Silver/Gold support while the regulated Private packaging notes use Standard/Enhanced/Enterprise. Which document is draft versus published, and can the cost model alone establish an approved customer quote?
The public board still says operational while their calls are failing. What do we collect first, and who is allowed to change that board?
For Redwood Private, which bundle version first includes "audit-export-connector", and which sinks does "auditExport" support?
